changesEN: Fixed Dark Mode black headings/labels caused by WPF TabControl foreground override so all text meets WCAG AA contrast
Added non-admin thermal zone temperature reading via Win32_PerfFormattedData_Counters_ThermalZoneInformation
Fixed 0px CornerRadius legacy settings migration, sidebar double focus border, and 0.0 W sparkline gridlines
Added interactive Schedule Rule Builder, 60%–100% quick limit presets, and human-readable status titles
fixesEN: Unchecked Sailing Mode automatically when OEM EC write is unavailable and added 1-click OEM App button in Power & Limits
Verified silent installer/uninstaller and v1.7.0.8 binary integrity on windows-latest
changesID: Perbaikan judul/label hitam di Dark Mode akibat override foreground WPF TabControl sehingga seluruh teks tajam & kontras
Pembacaan suhu non-admin via Win32_PerfFormattedData_Counters_ThermalZoneInformation sehingga Live Thermal Trend aktif
Perbaikan migrasi CornerRadius 0px dari settings lama, hilangkan double border fokus di sidebar, dan tambah gridlines + dot di sparkline
Tambah form pembuat jadwal interaktif (nama, jam, limit), preset cepat 60%–100%, dan judul status yang mudah dibaca
fixesID: Otomatis uncheck Sailing Mode saat EC write OEM tidak tersedia beserta tombol 1-klik aplikasi OEM di Power & Limits
